content:
maddie (eng-release): heads up — we discovered a schema edgecase in user-metadata parsing that causes rare 500s for very long email fields. reproducer in staging: payload with 1024 char email -> kvcache overflow. need a hotfix.
noah (oncall): how widespread in prod? any customer impact yet?
maddie (eng-release): only seen in a handful of EU1 requests (0.03% of traffic) but it's spiking on one customer ingestion job. they asked for quick patch.
sanjay (eng-runtime): fix is a single-line guard in parse_email + a quant-safe build. can patch and roll forward.
tiago (infra): how long to build + deploy to canary?
sanjay (eng-runtime): build+smoke ~8m, canary roll (10%) 15m, full roll 20m. total ~45m.
amanda (product): customer is on a paid contract — they want SLA-safe rollback plan. ops-lead: need expedited approvals for skipping staged canary?
ops-lead: request: expedite approval to (1) deploy hotfix to canary, (2) if metrics look good after 10m, roll to 100% but skip the 24h delayed window due to customer impact. please vote.
noah (oncall): I can approve if we keep rollback hook and a pin to previous image. also require changelog entry.
maddie (eng-release): agreed — will include release note blurb in PR and attach to incident tracker.
sanjay (eng-runtime): patch diff: 
```
- email = parse(field)
+ email = safe_parse(field, max_len=256)
```
quick test matrix: unit + staging smoke + kv cache warm-up.
deploybot: Initiating build for image redwood/inference:hotfix-schema-2026-03-21-0a1b2c. CI: passed (unit+smoke).
tiago (infra): I want telemetry guards — if error-rate > 0.5% or p95 latency regresses > 100ms in canary, auto-rollback. Can we attach those?
sanjay (eng-runtime): yes, adding autosentry rules and a deploybot policy: 
```
--rollback-if "error_rate>0.005 || p95_latency_delta>0.1"
```
ops-lead: Vote now — reply with :+1: to approve expedited roll to 100% after 10m green, or :-1: to require full 24h canary.
noah (oncall): :+1: — approve (keeping rollback triggers).
amanda (product): :+1: — customer-facing note ready.
tiago (infra): :+1: — infra cleared (kv warming included).
sanjay (eng-runtime): :+1: — build and deploy script updated.
maddie (eng-release): thanks. I'll document release notes here and run the deploy. Release note (short): 
- hotfix: enforce email length cap in user-metadata parser to avoid kvcache overflow and intermittent 500s. Impact: reduces error rate for long-email ingestion jobs. Rollout: canary -> 10m -> 100% (expedited).
releasebot: draft release note attached: https://reldoc.internal/r/1766666666-hotfix-schema-parse
deploybot: Starting canary rollout (10%) now. CID: cb-0a1b2c.
deploybot: Canary metrics (3m): error_rate down from 0.12% -> 0.01%, p95 latency stable (+3ms).
noah (oncall): can we accelerate to 100%? metrics look good, no alerts.
ops-lead: confirm we keep pin to previous image id. sanjay, can you push the previous image id to ops vault?
sanjay (eng-runtime): done — previous_image: redwood/inference:2026-03-20-e9f8a7 stored in vault at /ops/images/current-rollback.
maddie (eng-release): executing rollout to 100% with auto-rollback guard.
deploybot: Rolling to 100%...
deploybot: Rollout complete. all healthy. No alerts in 15m.
amanda (product): filing customer update now. summary: patch deployed, monitoring active, rollback plan ready.
noah (oncall): leaving follow-up checks for 24h but glad it's green.
maddie (eng-release): closing thread — release note pushed, changelog entry: "1766666666: hotfix/schema-email-cap". Thanks everyone. :tada:
